name: Mateo MacLeod
headline: Full-Stack Developer
summary: Versatile engineer with experience building customer-facing products and internal platforms across frontend, backend, and full-stack roles. Comfortable working on API integrations, data-driven features, and production support in fast-moving product teams. Known for shipping practical improvements that reduce defects, improve usability, and keep delivery moving.

roles.title: Junior Frontend Engineer
bullets: Built interactive user flows with Vue and GraphQL, cutting front-end defect reports by 28%.
Connected the browser layer to backend services through Express, improving data refresh times for 3 high-traffic screens.
Reviewed forms and content handling against OWASP guidance, helping reduce security issues before release.

roles.title: Backend Engineer
bullets: Developed API endpoints in Express and GraphQL for order and profile features used by 12 internal teams.
Designed SQL queries and schema changes that improved reporting speed by 35% on routine lookups.
Applied OWASP checks during delivery, reducing avoidable security review comments and rework.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Delivered feature flows in GraphQL and Redux, giving the product team a more predictable state model for releases.
Refactored shared client logic to simplify error handling and cut repeat bugs by 22%.
Partnered with designers and QA to tighten edge-case coverage across checkout and account updates.

roles.title: Backend Developer
bullets: Built and maintained services with Agile practices, Docker and REST APIs to support daily releases.
Delivered data-backed features across Next.js, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, improving dashboard response times by 31%.
Expanded GraphQL integrations for internal tools, reducing manual support work by 18% for the operations team.
Coordinated backend changes with frontend delivery so new product updates shipped with fewer release blockers.

projects.name: Cobalt Pipeline
projects.description: Built a messaging workflow with RabbitMQ and React to move jobs between service stages and show live processing status in the interface.
